Recompute rates

Source: R/pks_rates.R
pks_rates.Rd

Rates cannot be harmonized: when districts are merged or split, the published frequency (Haeufigkeitszahl, cases per 100,000 inhabitants) and clearance rate of the old districts do not carry over. pks_rates() recomputes them from the counts, with the population of the data or one you supply.

Usage

pks_rates(data, population = NULL, per = 1e+05)

Arguments

data

A tibble from pks_get().

population

NULL (default) to use the population in data (published where available, otherwise derived from cases and HZ), or a data frame with columns year, ags and population, for example from an official population source. Every row of data must find a population.

per

Rate denominator for column rate (default 100,000).

Value

data with hz (cases per 100,000) and clearance_rate recomputed, and a new column rate (cases per per). The population used is in column rate_population.

Details

Cases come from cases, or from cases_derived in the PDF years, where the BKA printed only rates. The clearance rate is 0 where cases are 0, as in the BKA tables.

Deutsch

Berechnet Häufigkeitszahl (Fälle je 100.000 Einwohner) und Aufklärungsquote neu aus den Fallzahlen, etwa nach einer Harmonisierung, bei der veröffentlichte Quoten nicht übertragen werden können. population kann eine eigene Einwohnerzahl je Jahr und Kreis liefern; per setzt den Nenner der neuen Spalte rate.

See also

Other analysis: pks_compare_weights(), pks_validate()

Examples

d <- pks_example()
pks_rates(d, per = 1000)[, c("year", "ags", "cases", "hz", "rate")]
